sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特惠，网址 nytimes.com 加上 subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Zolincano-Youngs, filling in as hoSt.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的佐林卡诺-扬斯，代班主持。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In the two years since a masked man shot and killed a healthcare executive, the national spotlight has turned to one primary suspect, Luigi Mangione.
sentences.zh: 在一个蒙面男子开枪打死一名医疗保健高管后的两年里，全国的目光都聚焦在头号嫌疑人路易吉·曼焦内身上。

sentences.en: Newly released video of the moment.
sentences.zh: 新发布的案发时视频。

sentences.en: Prosecutors say Luigi Mangione gunned down United Healthcare CEO Brian...
sentences.zh: 检方称路易吉·曼焦内枪杀联合健康首席执行官布莱恩……

sentences.en: In that notebook, though, apparently there's multiple notes, writings from Mangione, as well as other notes.
sentences.zh: 不过在这本笔记本里，显然有曼焦内的多条笔记、文字以及其他记录。

sentences.en: Mounting evidence collected by investigators continue to link 26-year-old Luigi Mangione to the murder.
sentences.zh: 调查人员收集的不断增加的证据继续将26岁的路易吉·曼焦内与这起谋杀案联系起来。

sentences.en: The overwhelming evidence has pointed to his guilt.
sentences.zh: 压倒性的证据指向他的罪行。

sentences.en: And the question on most minds has been, what might the defense of one of the most famous murder suspects in America look like?
sentences.zh: 大多数人心中最大的疑问是，美国最著名的谋杀嫌疑人之一会进行怎样的辩护？

sentences.en: A lot of anticipation and a line of people outside federal court in New York City today...
sentences.zh: 今天在纽约市联邦法院外有许多期待和排队的人……

sentences.en: On Friday, in a single hearing, we got our first glimpse at an answer, one that appears to include a full-throated embrace of his guilt.
sentences.zh: 周五，在一次听证会上，我们首次看到了答案，这个答案似乎包含对他的罪行的彻底坦白。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Benjamin Weiser and Harubi Mekko on the risky defense strategy of Luigi
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事本·韦瑟和哈鲁比·梅科将探讨路易吉令人捏一把汗的辩护策略

sentences.en: Mangione and why an admission of guilt might be his best bet.
sentences.zh: 曼焦内以及为什么认罪可能是他最好的选择。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月17日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Harubi and Ben, you two have been following the prosecution of Luigi Mangione for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 所以哈鲁比和本，你们俩追踪路易吉·曼焦内的起诉工作已经快两年了。

sentences.en: This has been happening on a number of different fronts.
sentences.zh: 这在好几个不同的方面都在发生。

sentences.en: I think it's overwhelming for many people.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对许多人来说是难以承受的。

sentences.en: Mangione faces multiple charges for multiple different crimes in both state and federal court,
sentences.zh: 曼焦内在地方法院和联邦法院都面临多项不同罪名的多项指控，

sentences.en: all centered around one act, the assassination of Brian Thompson, the United Healthcare CEO.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都围绕着一个行为，即暗杀联合健康首席执行官布莱恩·汤普森。

sentences.en: And on Friday, we got our first glimpse of how these different threads might play out in court.
sentences.zh: 周五，我们首次窥见这些不同的线索将如何在法庭上展开。

sentences.en: Ben, how would you characterize what we saw?
sentences.zh: 本，你觉得我们看到的景象是怎么样的？

sentences.en: All of the pieces of this brazen assassination from back in December 2024, the killing on a Manhattan sidewalk that really riveted the nation, fell into place in front of our eyes.
sentences.zh: 这起可以追溯到2024年12月的嚣张暗杀案的所有碎片——曼哈顿人行道上的那起真正震惊全国的谋杀案——在我们眼前拼凑在了一起。

sentences.en: And we heard from Mangione for the very first time in public.
sentences.zh: 我们也第一次在公开场合听到了曼焦内的声音。

sentences.en: When he pled guilty, he entered a guilty plea before a judge and explained what he had done that made him believe he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 当他认罪时，他在法官面前做出了有罪答辩，并解释了他所做的事情，这让他确信自己有罪。

sentences.en: A guilty plea.
sentences.zh: 认罪。

sentences.en: Harubi, when I hear that, I kind of wonder, OK, is this a wrap?
sentences.zh: 哈鲁比，当我听到这个时，我有点想知道，好吧，这算结束了吗？

sentences.en: Is it over?
sentences.zh: 结束了吗？

sentences.en: Is that the case?
sentences.zh: 案子就这样了吗？

sentences.en: Not quite.
sentences.zh: 并非如此。

sentences.en: So he's entered a guilty plea in the federal case, but he still has a state case that is still looming.
sentences.zh: 所以他在联邦案件中做了有罪答辩，但他还有一个悬而未决的州案件。

sentences.en: And there could be months of litigation on that front.
sentences.zh: 这方面可能还会有几个月的诉讼。

sentences.en: So the case is far from over.
sentences.zh: 所以案件远未结束。

sentences.en: Far from over.
sentences.zh: 远未结束。

sentences.en: OK, let's let's get into this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: Let's talk through the different elements of the state case, the federal case, all of these cases against Luigi Mangione.
sentences.zh: 让我们仔细分析州案件、联邦案件的各个要素，以及针对路易吉·曼焦内的所有这些案件。

sentences.en: How has his legal defense evolved from the moment of his arrest?
sentences.zh: 他的法律辩护从他被捕那一刻起是如何演变的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So from his arrest in Altoona, Pennsylvania, the Manhattan District Attorney's Office almost immediately charged him with 11 counts, including terrorism and second degree murder.
sentences.zh: 因此，从他在宾夕法尼亚州阿尔图纳被捕开始，曼哈顿地方检察官办公室几乎立即对他提出了11项指控，包括恐怖主义和二级谋杀。

sentences.en: And as he was being extradited to New York and as he landed in New York City, the Manhattan federal prosecutors announced that they, too, would be charging him.
sentences.zh: 正当他被引渡到纽约并在纽约市降落时，曼哈顿联邦检察官宣布他们也将对其实施指控。

sentences.en: Yeah, the United States Justice Department brought four counts.
sentences.zh: 是的，美国司法部提出了四项指控。

sentences.en: Notably, one was use of a firearm to commit murder, which carries a maximum potential sentence of death if the government decides to seek it.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，其中一项是使用枪支实施谋杀，如果政府决定寻求判处死刑，这将面临最高潜在死刑判决。

sentences.en: There were also two counts of interstate stalking, in a sense, stalking him over state lines, stalking the victim, resulting in the death of Thompson.
sentences.zh: 还有两项跨州跟踪指控，在某种意义上，跨州跟踪他，跟踪受害者，导致了汤普森的死亡。

sentences.en: And that carried a maximum sentence of life.
sentences.zh: 最高刑期为终身监禁。

sentences.en: There was an additional firearm charge, but those were the four counts initially brought by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 还有一项额外的枪支指控，但这些是联邦政府最初提出的四项指控。

sentences.en: And in announcing those charges, the United States Attorney at the time, this was the
sentences.zh: 在宣布这些指控时，当时的美国检察官，这是

sentences.en: Biden administration, said explicitly that they expected the Manhattan DA's office to try Mangione first and that the United States Attorney's Office would follow.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府时期，明确表示他们预计曼哈顿地方检察官办公室会首先审判曼焦内，而美国检察官办公室将随后跟进。

sentences.en: So, the feds are deferring to the state authorities in some way.
sentences.zh: 所以，联邦方面在某种程度上把案件交给了州当局。

sentences.en: They're saying, you're going to be kind of the lead on this and take the first crack at it.
sentences.zh: 他们是说，你们将在这个案件中担任主力并率先尝试吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But several months after Trump was elected and took office, the attorney general at the time, Pam Bondi, announced that the administration was going to seek the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普当选并就职几个月后，当时的司法部长帕姆·邦迪宣布，政府将寻求判处死刑。

sentences.en: So, once the feds were saying that, and at least appearing to accelerate the process, it
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦联邦方面这么说，并且至少看起来在加速这一进程，

sentences.en: was no longer clear that the federal government was going to defer to the state first, to the district attorney's office.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府是否会首先将案件交由州和地方检察官办公室处理，就变得不再明朗了。

sentences.en: I should add that there's always been a natural competitiveness between these two offices.
sentences.zh: 我还要补充一点，这两个办公室之间一直存在着一种天然的竞争关系。

sentences.en: It certainly goes back several decades, the period of time I've been covering the subject.
sentences.zh: 这当然可以追溯到几十年前，也就是我报道这个主题的时期。

sentences.en: But on top of that, there's something else between the two offices.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，这两个办公室之间还有点别的东西。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Attorney's Office, of course, is part of the Justice Department under President
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室，当然是总统领导下的司法部的一部分

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: And the district attorney is Alvin Bragg.
sentences.zh: 而地方检察官是阿尔文·布拉格。

sentences.en: And Alvin Bragg, of course, was the prosecutor whose office successfully prosecuted Donald Trump in 2024.
sentences.zh: 阿尔文·布拉格当然就是那个在2024年成功起诉唐纳德·特朗普的办公室的检察官。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And I mean, even just covering the White House, it is clear that there's no shortage of reasons why these two offices have tension.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅仅是报道白宫，就很清楚为什么这两个办公室之间会存在各种各样的紧张关系。

sentences.en: And I should add that both prosecutors' offices have said that they're pulling from the same well of evidence.
sentences.zh: 我还要补充一点，两家检察官办公室都表示，他们提取的都是同一份证据。

sentences.en: And that evidence, they've said from the beginning, is overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 他们从一开始就表示，这些证据是压倒性的。

sentences.en: Starting with, at the scene, there were shell casings found from the gun.
sentences.zh: 从现场开始，就找到了枪支的弹壳。

sentences.en: And at the time of Mangione's arrest as well, in a backpack, prosecutors have said there was
sentences.zh: 而在曼焦内被捕时，在一个背包里，检察官表示有

sentences.en: a whole lot of evidence with the gun itself, as well as a notebook where they said that he planned the attack.
sentences.zh: 大量证据，包括枪支本身，以及一本他们称之为记录了他策划袭击的笔记本。

sentences.en: And there was also a note with him that they've called a manifesto, which seemed to decry the
sentences.zh: 他们还随身携带了一份被他们称为宣言的便条，这似乎在谴责

sentences.en: health care insurance industry and essentially just spell out why he attacked and killed a health insurance executive.
sentences.zh: 医疗健康保险行业，并基本上阐明了他为什么袭击并杀死了一名健康保险高管。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Not to mention the evidence that the whole world saw, these videos of the shooting that went viral and very much marked this killing.
sentences.zh: 更不用说全世界都看到的证据了，这些在网上疯传并深深烙印在这场杀戮中的枪击视频。

sentences.en: So, Ben, tell us about how Mangione's defense team set out to navigate all of these charges, supported by all of this evidence that, you know, feels pretty overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 所以，本，跟我们讲讲曼焦内的辩护团队是如何着手应对所有这些指控的，这些指控背后有所有这些你懂的看起来相当压倒性的证据支持。

sentences.en: He certainly hired powerful lawyers, lawyers who have a wealth of experience in New York, both as prosecutors and defense lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他当然聘请了很有权势的律师，这些律师在纽约拥有丰富的经验，既当过检察官也当过辩护律师。

sentences.en: His lead lawyer, Karen Friedman Agnifolo, herself had worked in the Manhattan's DA's office as the number two prosecutor there.
sentences.zh: 他的首席律师卡伦·弗里德曼·阿尼福洛本人曾在曼哈顿地方检察官办公室担任二号检察官。

sentences.en: And her husband, Mark Agnifolo, represented some of the most prominent defendants in the city just in the last year or so.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫马克·阿尼福洛在过去一年左右的时间里曾代表过该市一些最知名的被告。

sentences.en: Sean Combs, did he, in his trial?
sentences.zh: 肖恩·库姆斯，他是不是也代理了？

sentences.en: That's a big case.
sentences.zh: 那是个大案子。

sentences.en: So their challenge, once Mr. Mangione was in custody, was first to attack the charges.
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦曼焦内先生被拘留，他们面临的挑战首先就是反击这些指控。

sentences.en: And through filings in both the state and federal court and a lot of vigorous argument, they ultimately succeeded in getting the state terrorism charge against him dropped.
sentences.zh: 通过在州和联邦法院提交文件以及大量的强力辩论，他们最终成功撤销了针对他的州恐怖主义指控。

sentences.en: And the federal count that carried the potential death penalty was also dismissed.
sentences.zh: 带有潜在死刑的联邦指控也被驳回了。

sentences.en: So it seems like they got some momentum.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来他们取得了一些势头。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: They still faced another great challenge, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们仍然面临着另一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: All of that evidence that had been collected and tied by prosecutors to Mangione was out there.
sentences.zh: 检察官收集并与曼焦内联系起来的所有这些证据都摆在那里。

sentences.en: And that was the evidence that would be presented against him in any trial he faced in New York, a state or federal court.
sentences.zh: 这些就是在他在纽约面对的任何审判中（无论是州法院还是联邦法院）针对他的证据。

sentences.en: And so they filed motions in both courts to suppress the evidences.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们向两家法院提交了排除证据的动议。

sentences.en: I just wanted to jump in very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我只想非常简短地插一句。

sentences.en: The suppression of the evidence and the defense lawyer's arguments are really pointed to the time that Mangione was arrested in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 排除证据和辩护律师的论点实际上直指曼焦内在宾夕法尼亚州被捕的时间。

sentences.en: They argue that when the Altoona Police Department searched his backpack, at first, there was no warrant.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，当阿尔图纳警察局最初搜查他的背包时，并没有搜查令。

sentences.en: So everything that was pulled out should not have been pulled out of the backpack, that that violated his rights.
sentences.zh: 所以所有被搜出来的内容都不应该被搜出来，这侵犯了他的权利。

sentences.en: And essentially, they make a fruit of the poison tree argument and say that, therefore, anything that was in that backpack should not be allowed into a trial at all.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，他们提出了毒树果实理论的论点，并表示因此背包里的任何东西都不应该被允许进入审判。

sentences.en: And they tried that both in the federal and state case.
sentences.zh: 他们在联邦和州的案件中都尝试了这一点。

sentences.en: In the federal case, the judge overseeing that one quickly ruled that actually, under federal law, everything is allowed into a trial.
sentences.zh: 在联邦案件中，监督该案的法官很快裁定，实际上根据联邦法律，所有东西都是可以作为审判证据的。

sentences.en: And in the state case, the judge decided that some evidence should be suppressed, but allowed in two very important pieces of evidence for state prosecutors,
sentences.zh: 而在州案件中，法官裁定应排除部分证据，但允许州检察官使用两项非常重要的证据，

sentences.en: which was the gun that they said was connected to the killing and a notebook that they say detailed his plans to kill Brian Thompson.
sentences.zh: 也就是他们所说与凶杀案有关的枪支，以及他们所说详细记录了他谋杀布莱恩·汤普森计划的笔记本。

sentences.en: Okay, so essentially, this effort to suppress the evidence, it doesn't really work.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以基本上，这种排除证据的努力并没有真正起作用。

sentences.en: Where does the defense team go from there?
sentences.zh: 辩护团队接下来去哪里？

sentences.en: So the question after that became, are they having any kinds of plea negotiations with the prosecutors?
sentences.zh: 因此，在那之后的问题变成了，他们是否正在与检察官进行任何形式的认罪协商？

sentences.en: And just generally, any good defense lawyer would always be in talks with prosecutors throughout the case.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，任何优秀的辩护律师在整个案件审理过程中都会一直与检察官保持沟通。

sentences.en: This would be essentially a deal for Mangione to plea guilty on a lesser charge for a lesser sentence.
sentences.zh: 这基本上将是一项交易，即曼焦内以较轻的罪名认罪以换取较轻的刑罚。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: It could be the same charge.
sentences.zh: 可能是相同的罪名。

sentences.en: It could be a lesser charge.
sentences.zh: 可能是较轻的罪名。

sentences.en: But it would be an effort for Mangione and his team to mitigate either the charges that he's facing or the sentence that he could possibly face.
sentences.zh: 但这将是曼焦内及其团队为了减轻他所面临的指控或可能面临的刑期而做出的努力。

sentences.en: But there was no public evidence, at least on the state side, that there had been any kinds of negotiations or any talks.
sentences.zh: 但至少在州这一边，没有公开证据表明曾有过任何形式的谈判或讨论。

sentences.en: On the contrary, state prosecutors had been very vocal that they wanted to go to trial.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，州检察官一直非常大声地表示他们想要开庭审理。

sentences.en: They felt they had a very strong case, and the state trial was fast approaching.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得他们掌握了非常充分的证据，而且州审判即将来临。

sentences.en: There was a hearing on Tuesday where the state judge announced that the jury would be anonymous, and he told everyone, I will see you on September 8th.
sentences.zh: 周二有一场听证会，州法官宣布陪审团将是匿名的，他对所有人说，我们9月8日见。

sentences.en: Okay, so after that, it looks like Mangione is going to have to go to court and defend himself against murder charges pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在那之后，看起来曼焦内很快就得去法庭为自己面临的谋杀指控进行辩护了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then on a day last week, the same day that the judge in the state court held his final hearing before the trial,
sentences.zh: 然后在上周的某一天，也就是州法院法官在审判前举行最后听证会的同一天，

sentences.en: the federal court posted a notice saying that a hearing was being scheduled for Friday morning for reasons that were not described.
sentences.zh: 联邦法院发布了一则通知，称由于未说明的原因，定于周五上午举行听证会。

sentences.en: And that brought us to a federal courtroom on Friday where Mangione made his appearance.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了周五的一个联邦法庭，曼焦内在那里出庭了。

sentences.en: And what did we see in that federal courtroom on Friday?
sentences.zh: 我们在周五的那个联邦法庭上看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, Mangione sat there between his lawyers and gave what's called an allocution, a statement in which he admitted to what he did that added up to guilt in this case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，曼焦内坐在他的律师中间，发表了所谓的认罪陈述，即他承认了在这起案件中构成罪行的行为的一份声明。

sentences.en: The two stalking charges that led to Mr. Thompson's death.
sentences.zh: 导致汤普森先生死亡的两项跟踪指控。

sentences.en: He talked about learning that UnitedHealthcare was holding an annual investor conference in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他谈到得知联合健康保险公司正在纽约市举行年度投资者会议。

sentences.en: He researched the event online,
sentences.zh: 他在网上搜索了有关该活动的信息，

sentences.en: and he said he emailed UnitedHealthcare leadership posing as an investor at a firm that he said was managing over $50 billion in assets and asking for more information about the conference.
sentences.zh: 他说他以一家管理资产超过500亿美元的公司的投资者的身份，向联合健康领导层发送了电子邮件，询问有关会议的更多信息。

sentences.en: And he said, and this is a direct quote, unlike my previous interactions with insurers, I received an immediate response within an hour, end quote,
sentences.zh: 他说，这是直接引语，“与我以前与保险公司的互动不同，我在一小时内收到了立即回复，引文结束”，

sentences.en: suggesting against that they were happy to respond to a wealthy investor, even if they, in his perspective, weren't treating their patients very well.
sentences.zh: 这表明，尽管从他的角度来看，他们并没有很好地对待患者，但他们仍然乐于回应一个富有投资者。

sentences.en: He also mentioned that he had endured years of severe pain from what he said was a broken back and that he had had to navigate the obstacles of the health insurance system.
sentences.zh: 他还提到，他多年来一直忍受着他所说的断背带来的剧烈痛楚，并且不得不应对健康保险系统的种种障碍。

sentences.en: So here he is making clear statements about his opinions that might also suggest his motivation.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，他清楚地表达了自己观点的声明，这可能也暗示了他的动机。

sentences.en: He talked about using a 3D printer to make part of a gun, which he equipped with a silencer and a magazine.
sentences.zh: 他谈到使用3D打印机制作枪支的一部分，并为之配备了消音器和弹匣。

sentences.en: And he also talked about traveling from outside New York to Manhattan to carry out this assassination.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到从纽约以外的地方前往曼哈顿执行这次暗杀。

sentences.en: And he said, my travel to New York and my email to UnitedHealthcare was with the intent to shoot Brian Thompson.
sentences.zh: 他说，我去纽约以及给联合健康的邮件都是为了枪击布莱恩·汤普森。

sentences.en: This is the first time we have Mangione or his team, like, addressing any of this, right?
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次看到曼焦内或他的团队以这种方式谈论这一切，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we haven't heard from him in this kind of way yet until this moment, no?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在此之前我们从未以这种方式听到过他的声音，对吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then this allocution culminated with his statement that on the morning of December 4, 2024, and again, I'm quoting him, I shot Mr. Thompson in Manhattan and he died.
sentences.zh: 然后，这段认罪陈述在他的声明中达到高潮，他说在2024年12月4日的早晨，再次引用他的话，“我在曼哈顿枪击了汤普森先生，他死了。”

sentences.en: When I did so, I understood that my actions would place him in fear of death and serious bodily injury.
sentences.zh: 当我这么做时，我明白我的行为会让他感到死亡和严重身体伤害的恐惧。

sentences.en: I knew what I was doing was illegal, end quote.
sentences.zh: 我知道我在做违法的的事情，引文结束。

sentences.en: So, Harubi, as I hear these details, all of these seem like details that would hurt Mangione's case.
sentences.zh: 所以，哈鲁比，当我听到这些细节时，所有这些似乎都是会损害曼焦内案件的细节。

sentences.en: It almost seems like he could just be, like, burning the house down here as he admits this guilt.
sentences.zh: 这看起来几乎就像他在承认罪行时在把整栋房子付之一炬。

sentences.en: What were your reactions to what he was saying in court that day?
sentences.zh: 你对那天他在法庭上说的话有什么反应？

sentences.en: My first thought, especially as he started reading from a prepared statement and giving all of these details,
sentences.zh: 我的第一反应，尤其是当他开始宣读准备好的声明并提供所有这些细节时，

sentences.en: is it's remarkable to have all of this information after nearly two years.
sentences.zh: 时隔近两年，能掌握所有这些信息真是太惊人了。

sentences.en: To hear from him why he killed Brian Thompson and the details of the planning and everything that he gave.
sentences.zh: 听他讲述自己为什么要杀害布莱恩·汤普森，以及谋划的细节和提供的一切内容。

sentences.en: And my immediate second thought is that far from burning down the house, that this was a strategic move from Mangione and his lawyers to upend the state case.
sentences.zh: 而我的第二个直觉是，这远非破釜沉舟，而是曼吉奥内及其律师为了推翻州诉讼而采取的一项战略举动。

sentences.en: Because as we were paying attention to the words that he was saying in that courtroom, so were the prosecutors with the Manhattan District Attorney's Office just down the street.
sentences.zh: 因为就在我们关注他在法庭上所说的话时，马哈顿地方检察官办公室的检察官们就在几条街之外，也同样在关注着。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 回想当年在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件你最珍视的藏品去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成这样一个充满活力的、像50年前精美老物件的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com斜杠games，今天就开始游戏。

sentences.en: Okay, so Harubi, help me understand why Mangione's lawyers would offer this blunt, detailed admission of guilt in this way.
sentences.zh: 好的，哈鲁比，帮我理解一下，为什么曼吉奥内的律师会以这种方式做出如此直白、详细的认罪供述？

sentences.en: Like, on first glance, it doesn't really make sense.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这似乎不太合常理。

sentences.en: It doesn't track.
sentences.zh: 这说不通。

sentences.en: But I'm sure you've got a better understanding than me on this.
sentences.zh: 但我相信你在这方面的理解比我更深透。

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what the discussions were between Mangione and his lawyers.
sentences.zh: 我们并不确切知道曼吉奥内和他的律师之间进行了怎样的讨论。

sentences.en: However, what we do know is within an hour of his plea, his lawyers file a motion in state court making two arguments.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们所知道的是，在他认罪后不到一个小时，他的律师就在州法院提交了一份动议，提出了两个论点。

sentences.en: One, they say there are due process violations.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们表示存在违反法定正当程序的情况。

sentences.en: And the second piece, they argue that now that Mangione has pleaded guilty to federal charges, that now this is essentially a double jeopardy case in the state venue,
sentences.zh: 第二部分，他们辩称，既然曼吉奥内已经对联邦指控认罪，那么这在本质上已经构成了州管辖区内的双重 jeopardy 案件，

sentences.en: and the state case should be tossed out.
sentences.zh: 并且州层面的诉讼应当予以驳回。

sentences.en: Okay, double jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 好的，双重审判。

sentences.en: If I have this right, we're essentially talking about the argument that somebody cannot be tried twice for the same crime.
sentences.zh: 如果我没理解错的话，我们本质上是在讨论这样一种论点：一个人不能因同一罪名接受两次审判。

sentences.en: But hearing you guys talk about this, I thought that we had different charges here, that each of these entities, state and feds, they're bringing different charges.
sentences.zh: 但听你们讨论这个，我原以为我们这里有不同的罪名，州和联邦这两个实体分别提出了不同的指控。

sentences.en: So how does double jeopardy apply here?
sentences.zh: 所以双重审判原则在这里是如何适用的呢？

sentences.en: That's likely what the Manhattan District Attorney's Office is going to argue against this mission to dismiss, is that the federal case and the state case
sentences.zh: 这很可能是曼哈顿地方检察官办公室用来反驳这起驳回动议的理由，即联邦案件和州案件

sentences.en: are designed to address different harms, where it's the stalking charges in the federal case, and the state case is very different because he's actually being tried for murder.
sentences.zh: 旨在应对不同的危害，联邦案件针对的是跟踪指控，而州案件则截然不同，因为他实际上是以谋杀罪受审。

sentences.en: Right, different institutions, different charges.
sentences.zh: 没错，不同的机构，不同的指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But New York state law has broader protections for defendants.
sentences.zh: 但纽约州法律对被告有更广泛的保护。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: What Mangione's lawyers are arguing, under state law, is the fact that he's already pleaded guilty to stalking, which led to Brian Thompson's death,
sentences.zh: 曼吉奥内的律师根据州法律提出的辩护理由是，鉴于他已经承认犯有导致布莱恩·汤普森死亡的跟踪罪，

sentences.en: that the state case is automatically double jeopardied out.
sentences.zh: 州层面的诉讼将自动因双重审判原则而被排除。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so that detailed confession he gave, I imagine that was actually key to this argument.
sentences.zh: 所以他给出的那个详细供述，我想这实际上是这一论点的关键所在。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It could become very key.
sentences.zh: 这可能成为非常关键的一环。

sentences.en: But Ben, clarify something for me here.
sentences.zh: 但本，你帮我澄清一件事。

sentences.en: What does Mangione actually have to gain in this situation?
sentences.zh: 曼吉奥内在这种情况下到底能得到什么好处？

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: You guys have articulated this strategy, but if he does this, like, he's still going to be convicted in federal court, right?
sentences.zh: 你们阐述了这一战略，但如果他这么做，他仍然会被联邦法院定罪，对吧？

sentences.en: So what is the benefit of his lawyers directing him to follow this route, this strategy?
sentences.zh: 那么，他的律师指导他走这条路、采取这种战略，究竟有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: Well, of course, he has been convicted now, and thus we know he faces up to life in prison, and under the guidelines, could face less time.
sentences.zh: 当然，他现在已经被定罪了，因此我们知道他面临最高终身监禁，而根据量刑指南，也可能会面临更短的刑期。

sentences.en: Perhaps less time that would allow him, if he was sentenced to less time, to walk out of prison before he was 60 years old.
sentences.zh: 也许更短的刑期能让他，如果被判处较短刑期的话，在60岁之前就能走出监狱。

sentences.en: And the truth is, in state court, if he were convicted there, he faces a 25 years to life sentence on a second degree murder charge,
sentences.zh: 事实是，在州法院，如果他被判有罪，他将面临二级谋杀罪25年至无期徒刑的判决，

sentences.en: which, again, in a theoretical sense, would allow him to walk out of prison as well.
sentences.zh: 这从理论上讲，同样能让他有朝一日走出监狱。

sentences.en: But the bottom line is that by pleading guilty, as he has, he at least has a chance, you would think, or his lawyers think, to get rid of that state case altogether.
sentences.zh: 但最底线的是，通过像现在这样认罪，你或者他的律师会认为，他至少有机会彻底摆脱那个州诉讼。

sentences.en: It's a better deal for them to only be facing one sentence than two.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，只面对一项判决总比两项要好，这是一笔更好的买卖。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So it may be that the feds aren't more lenient than the state prosecutors, but that's actually besides the point.
sentences.zh: 所以，联邦可能并不比州检察官更宽大，但这其实并不是重点。

sentences.en: The strategy here is more so that by Luigi Mangione bending the knee on one track here, he actually may have a higher chance of eliminating that second track,
sentences.zh: 这里的战略更多在于，通过路易吉·曼吉奥内在一条轨道上屈服，他实际上可能会有更高的几率消除第二条轨道，

sentences.en: meaning that he could face an outcome where he only needs to deal with one trial.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他可能面对只需应对一场审判的结果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he could, if he's very lucky, get a sentence that would allow him to walk out of prison.
sentences.zh: 如果他非常幸运的话，他甚至可以得到一个能让他走出监狱的判决。

sentences.en: But he has to be very lucky that there's no state case at all.
sentences.zh: 但他必须非常幸运，确保根本没有州诉讼才行。

sentences.en: Just to jump in very quickly, if his strategy doesn't work and a state trial does go forward, everything he has said during that hearing, his admission,
sentences.zh: 插话一句，如果他的战略没有奏效，州审判真的推进了，他在那场听证会上所说的一切，他的供述，

sentences.en: all of that could be admissible in a trial against him.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都可能成为针对他的审判中的呈堂证供。

sentences.en: So it's a, on some level, it is a risky maneuver.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，这是一个冒险的举动。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So it seems like this detailed admission of guilt we got from Mangione, I understand how it plays into this double jeopardy strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来，我们从曼吉奥内那里得到的这份详细认罪供述，我明白它是如何配合这种双重审判战略的了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I also wonder how it might play into something broader.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我也在想它可能会如何融入更宏大的某些事物中。

sentences.en: Like, in the minds of some, Luigi Mangione had become something bigger.
sentences.zh: 比如，在某些人心中，路易吉·曼吉奥内已经变成了一个更伟大的人物。

sentences.en: He had become this idol for standing up against the healthcare insurance industry.
sentences.zh: 他已经成为了一个敢于挺身对抗医疗保险行业的偶像。

sentences.en: So, Harubi, I wonder if you've examined not only how his admission of guilt and really his detailed explanation of his motive, not only how that factored into his legal strategy,
sentences.zh: 所以，哈鲁比，我想知道你是否审视过，不仅是他的认罪以及他对其动机的详细解释如何融入他的法律战略，

sentences.en: but also how that factors into the broader cultural conversation around this case.
sentences.zh: 而且还审视了这如何融入围绕此案的更广泛的文化对话中。

sentences.en: Well, it might be the first time that we've heard Luigi Mangione admit to the killing in this case.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可能是我们第一次听到路易吉·曼吉奥内在此案中承认杀人。

sentences.en: For some of his supporters, they've just understood that it was him and that they were supporting him because they saw his action as the actions of a vigilante
sentences.zh: 对于他的一些支持者来说，他们早就知道是他干的，他们支持他是因为他们把他的行动看作是一个义警的行动，

sentences.en: or someone that was standing up to this bigger, larger force, which is the healthcare insurance industry, and the harms that that has been doing to the average American.
sentences.zh: 或者是一个敢于挺身对抗这个更庞大力量（即医疗保险行业）及其对普通美国人造成的伤害的人。

sentences.en: So I don't think it's as shocking or surprising or turning away some of his most ardent supporters.
sentences.zh: 所以我不认为这会显得多么令人震惊、意外，或者会让他的一些最狂热的支持者离他而去。

sentences.en: It's interesting, though, given what Mangione said in court, the government responded to it afterwards.
sentences.zh: 不过有趣的是，鉴于曼吉奥内在法庭上所说的话，政府随后做出了回应。

sentences.en: Just a few moments ago, Mangione pled guilty to his heinous act.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，曼吉奥内对他的滔天罪行表示认罪。

sentences.en: This was not a spontaneous act of violence.
sentences.zh: 这不是一次自发的暴力行为。

sentences.en: It was deliberate, calculated, and premeditated.
sentences.zh: 这是蓄意、经过计算和预谋的。

sentences.en: Jamie McDonald, who has just been named the U.S.
sentences.zh: 杰米·麦克唐纳刚刚被任命为南部地区美国检察官，

sentences.en: attorney for the Southern District, went outside with other law enforcement officials and spoke to the press.
sentences.zh: 他与其它执法官员一同走出来并向媒体发表了讲话。

sentences.en: And he addressed the larger cultural conversation that this case had provoked.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了此案引发的更广泛的文化对话。

sentences.en: The defendant committed this murder in an attempt to draw public attention to his dislike of certain businesses.
sentences.zh: 被告犯下这起谋杀案，是企图引起公众对我方对某些企业的不满的关注。

sentences.en: But we live in a civilized society governed by the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 但我们生活在一个由法治统治的文明社会中。

sentences.en: He essentially said there's nothing honorable about this.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，这没有什么光彩可言。

sentences.en: This is, you know, an assassination we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一场暗杀。

sentences.en: No grievance, political belief, or ideological cause can ever justify murder.
sentences.zh: 任何冤屈、政治信仰或意识形态诉求都绝不能成为谋杀的借口。

sentences.en: He said, you know, we don't commit murder just because of political grievance or ideological causes.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们不能仅仅因为政治冤屈或意识形态诉求就去谋杀。

sentences.en: There can be no celebrity in assassination.
sentences.zh: 暗杀中绝无什么名人效应可言。

sentences.en: Any person who celebrates, encourages, or excuses actions like these is fundamentally wrong.
sentences.zh: 任何庆祝、鼓励或原谅此类行为的人都是彻底错误的。

sentences.en: I know as beat reporters that we never want to lean into predictions in this business.
sentences.zh: 我知道作为突发新闻记者，我们在这个行业里从不做预测。

sentences.en: But I do want to ask where things go next in this case and what we can expect the outcome of Mangione's risky move to be here.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想问，这个案件接下来会走向何方，我们能预料到曼吉奥内这一冒险举动的结局会是什么。

sentences.en: Well, for sure, one thing that's coming in December is his sentencing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可以肯定的一点是，12月份将迎来他的量刑宣判。

sentences.en: Mangione will appear before the judge in the federal case.
sentences.zh: 曼吉奥内将在联邦案件中出庭面对法官。

sentences.en: And one aspect of the sentencing that I believe we can expect is that the family of the victim,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以预期量刑的一个方面是，受害者的家属，

sentences.en: Mr. Thompson's family, will be given the opportunity to speak and talk about the impact on them that his death has had.
sentences.zh: 汤普森先生的家属，将获得发言机会，讲述他的死对他们造成的打击。

sentences.en: And, of course, Mangione will be given an opportunity to speak.
sentences.zh: 当然，曼吉奥内也将获得发言机会。

sentences.en: Not every defendant speaks at sentencing, but most do.
sentences.zh: 并非每个被告在量刑时都会发言，但大多数人会。

sentences.en: And given what he said and his plea, it will be interesting to see how far he goes in whatever he says, if he says anything, before the judge imposes sentence.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他所说的话和他的认罪，看看他在法官宣判前所说的话（如果他说的话的话）会走多远，将是一件很有意思的事。

sentences.en: On the state side, the district attorney's office has said that they would litigate that motion to dismiss filed by Mangione's lawyers.
sentences.zh: 在州诉讼方面，地方检察官办公室表示，他们将对曼吉奥内律师提交的驳回动议进行诉讼交锋。

sentences.en: And it could really turn into months of court hearings, filings back and forth, and litigation.
sentences.zh: 这真的可能会演变成数月的法庭听证会、来回的文件提交以及诉讼拉锯战。

sentences.en: So this case is not over.
sentences.zh: 所以这个案件还没有结束。

sentences.en: Ben, Harubi, thank you so much for breaking it all down.
sentences.zh: 本，哈鲁比，非常感谢你们的全面剖析。

sentences.en: Thank you, Zola.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，佐拉。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us, Zola.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们，佐拉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Can you pledge that the Justice Department will always act independently of the White House?
sentences.zh: 你能保证司法部将始终独立于白宫行事吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's a big difference between saying we will always do our job and investigate any case and act independently of the White House.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说我们会始终履行职责、调查任何案件并独立于白宫行事，这两者之间有很大区别。

sentences.en: No, I'm not going to pledge that.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会做出这种保证。

sentences.en: And no attorney general should ever pledge that.
sentences.zh: 任何总检察长也永远不应该做出这种保证。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Todd Blanche, President Trump's newly confirmed attorney general
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普总统新确认的司法部长、

sentences.en: and former personal attorney, refused to say that he would always act independently of White House influence.
sentences.zh: 同时也是前私人律师的托德·布兰奇拒绝承诺他将始终独立于白宫的影响行事。

sentences.en: Questions over Blanche's loyalty to Trump had nearly derailed his nomination to lead the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 关于布兰奇对特朗普忠诚度的质疑几乎破坏了他领导司法部的提名。

sentences.en: But Blanche told NBC's Meet the Press that Trump had never asked him to do anything illegal or unethical.
sentences.zh: 但布兰奇对美国全国广播公司（NBC）的《会见新闻界》节目表示，特朗普从未要求他做任何违法或不道德的事情。

sentences.en: Blanche later said in an interview with Fox News that he was not afraid to push back against Trump.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇后来在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，他并不害怕顶撞特朗普。

sentences.en: If he and I have disagreements or if there's something that he has questions about legally,
sentences.zh: 如果他和我有分歧，或者有什么法律问题是他有疑问的，

sentences.en: that it's my job to talk to him about those issues, which I have done for many years and I will continue.
sentences.zh: 我的工作就是同他讨论这些问题，我多年来一直这样做，也将继续这样做。

sentences.en: And the head of U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国中央司令部负责人对围绕“林肯”号航母（一艘支持美国打击伊朗行动的美国航空母舰）引发的关切做出了回应。

sentences.en: Central Command responded to concerns raised about the USS Lincoln, an American aircraft carrier supporting U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国中央司令部负责人对围绕“林肯”号航母（一艘支持美国对伊朗军事行动的美国航空母舰）引发的关切做出了回应。

sentences.en: operations against Iran.
sentences.zh: 各项行动。

sentences.en: The ship has been deployed for nearly nine months, with reports showing shortages of basic supplies,
sentences.zh: 该舰已部署近九个月，据报道，舰上5000名水兵面临基本补给短缺、水污染以及心理健康恶化的问题。

sentences.en: water contamination and deteriorating mental health among the 5,000 sailors on the ship.
sentences.zh: 舰上5000名水兵面临基本物资短缺、水污染以及心理健康状况恶化的问题。

sentences.en: President Trump has dismissed those concerns.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对这些关切不以为然。

sentences.en: But on Sunday, Admiral Brad Cooper acknowledged that long deployment at sea is, quote, uniquely challenging and tough.
sentences.zh: 但周日，布拉德·库珀海军上将承认，长期海上部署“确实具有独特的挑战性和艰难性”。

sentences.en: But he insisted that the ship has the lowest number of cases related to mental health among the Navy's 11 active aircraft carriers.
sentences.zh: 但他坚称，在海军11艘现役航空母舰中，该舰与心理健康相关的病例数是最低的。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由亚历克斯·斯特恩和罗谢尔·邦贾制作。

sentences.zh: 由迈克尔·勒努瓦和罗布·齐普科编辑，并包含莉亚·肖·达梅伦和丹·鲍威尔的音乐。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由旺德利创作。

sentences.zh: 本期节目的音频工程由克里斯·伍德制作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是佐莉坎诺·杨斯。

sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·科尼格主持的《都会》最新一期节目中，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都会。

sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
